articles.summary: ATLANTA, Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oxford Industries, Inc. (NYSE:OXM) today announced financial results for its second quarter of fiscal 2026 ended August 1, 2026. Consolidated net sales in the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $394 million compared to $403 million in the second quarter
articles.title: Oxford: Owner of Tommy Bahama, Lilly Pulitzer and Johnny Was Reports Second Quarter Results
